proposals.title: Re-attempt monorepo bootstrap using npm workspaces to eliminate the pnpm resolution blocker
proposals.why_now: TASK-0001 has been rejected three times. The single root cause across all three rejections is that the authoritative validation environment cannot resolve the pnpm binary — it resolves /workspace/pnpm as a directory. Attempt-03 introduced a pnpm shim that silently no-ops the install command, which the reviewer flagged as a MAJOR finding that weakens a required CI gate. npm is universally available in any Node environment with no extra provisioning. Switching to npm workspaces removes the root cause entirely. The repository has zero accepted production commits after 18 cycles; this task is the absolute prerequisite for every other deliverable.

proposals.title: Write ADR-002 (hash function), ADR-004 (rounding enforcement), and ADR-009 (CanonicalEncoder) before packages/core is implemented
proposals.why_now: All three ADRs are explicit prerequisites before any implementation may begin. §15 FASE-1 acceptance requires ADR-009 written and the encoder implemented before any state hash exists. ADR-002 requires the hash function specified bit-by-bit in an ADR before any rand() implementation. ADR-004 marks the technical mechanism for enforcing rounding-mode declaration as DEFINIR. Implementing packages/core without these ADRs embeds unrecorded decisions that cannot be reversed without an encodingVersion bump and invalidation of all future reference StateHashes. These documents touch only docs/decisions/ and can be prepared in parallel with or immediately after IDEA-001.

proposals.title: packages/core — branded numeric types, positional RNG, division helpers, and CanonicalEncoder
proposals.why_now: packages/core is the dependency of every other pure package. Without branded types (Money, Quantity, Price, Rate as bigint; Tick and noise indices as number restricted to safe integers), the type system cannot enforce ADR-003 or ADR-004 and violations accumulate silently from the first implementation file. Without positional rand() implementing ADR-002, packages/world cannot be written. Without CanonicalEncoder implementing ADR-009, no StateHash can be computed and INV-01, INV-17, INV-22 have no foundation. This is the second foundational step after the monorepo and ADRs.

proposals.title: packages/world price generator, packages/domain ledger and market orders, packages/application canonical tick loop
proposals.why_now: These three packages compose the functional core of FASE-1. The price generator delivers INV-02 (described as the most important test in the project). The double-entry multi-commodity ledger delivers INV-04 through INV-07. The canonical tick loop implements the ten-step locked order from §7, which is a FASE-1 acceptance criterion. application is the only layer that composes world and domain without coupling them; none of the core invariants can be fully verified in isolation — they become testable only when composed through application. A DEFINIR for transcendental functions in log-space price construction must be resolved via ADR before world is implemented.

proposals.title: tools/replay, tools/bench, minimum Electron UI and installers to complete FASE-1 acceptance
proposals.why_now: FASE-1 acceptance requires tools/replay (reporting the first divergent tick), tools/bench (with calibration ratios frozen in a versioned file per §18 protocol), a minimum UI (lightweight-charts price chart, BRL balance, buy/sell market order buttons, pause and 1x controls, permanent non-dismissable disclaimer in Portuguese per §20), and installers for Windows and Linux produced by CI. The performance baseline must be frozen in FASE-1 — deferring it means the bench gate has no reference for the rest of the project. The installers must exist in minimum form in FASE-1 because deferred packaging causes ABI and module-native failures that are not correctable locally once architecture is established.

DEFINIR BLOCKER — transcendental functions for price generation: §5.1 constructs prices in log-space using Math.log and Math.exp. Both are prohibited in pure packages by §13. An ADR specifying a fixed-point or lookup-table implementation producing bit-identical results across platforms must be written before packages/world can be implemented. This ADR has not yet been written and is a prerequisite for IDEA-004.

DEFINIR BLOCKER — octave parameters: the number of octaves, periods, and amplitudes for trendLayer and idiosyncraticNoise are DEFINIR per §5.1 and must be fixed in a versioned configuration file with an ADR before the price generator is implemented, because any post-implementation change requires an encodingVersion bump and invalidates all frozen reference StateHashes.

DEFINIR BLOCKER — tools/* dependency edges: §14.5 defines edges for packages and apps but not for tools/*. tools/replay and tools/bench will need to import from packages to fulfill FASE-1 acceptance items. An ADR or SPEC_BLOCKERS.md entry is required before those tools acquire cross-workspace imports, or the boundary checker will reject them.
